Type: distressed medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or bed area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, traditional, contemporary
Materials: low-pile woven synthetic, faded vintage-wash finish
Colors: hot pink, coral orange, navy blue, cream
Shape: rectangular, all-over faded floral medallion pattern, layered borders, worn antique look, large
Feel: vibrant, eclectic, warm
Goes with: grey or white upholstery, dark wood floors, natural baskets, brass accents; bohemian or eclectic rooms

product.name: Rivet Vibrant Medallion Rug, 7'6" x 9'6", Pink
product.description: The vibrant colors and medallion design of this rug are sure to add an exciting pop of style to any room. Its beautiful hues of deep rouge outlined in blue make it the perfect addition to neutral décor. Distressed floral design Bright pattern with blue border, machine-woven in Turkey with long-lasting, 100% polypropylene fibers Low, 0.2" pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 7'6" x 9'6" Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for fibers to settle
